content:
We keep getting parsing errors. Possibly the system expects the JSON to be on a single line without line breaks and without spaces after commas? But earlier multi-line worked. However maybe the issue is that the JSON contains newline characters inside the <action_input> tags, causing the parser to stop early. The earlier successful calls had multi-line JSON and were recognized (the first search gave execution_error). So something else.

Look at the earlier successful call: The first attempt with functional groups gave execution_error and was recognized. That call had multi-line JSON with line breaks. So parsing works.

Now the error "No actions to execute" indicates the system didn't detect the <action> tag. Could be because we included extra spaces before closing tag? In our last response we had:

<action_input>{
    ...
}
</action_input>

Note we added a newline before </action_input>. In earlier calls we had </action_input> directly after JSON without newline. Maybe the parser expects closing tag on same line? The earlier calls had </action_input> on same line? Let's check earlier: The first successful call (the one that gave execution_error) had:

<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "...",
    "functional_groups_broken": [...],
    ...
}</action_input>

Yes, closing tag on same line. In our last, we placed newline before closing tag, which may break regex. So we need to keep closing tag on same line.

Let's redo with proper format: single line closing.

Also ensure no extra spaces after tags.

We'll try a simple search with functional_groups_broken ["ketones"] and functional_groups_formed ["aliphatic hydroxyls"] limit 5.
